notes_for_editor: The NGS station is named Onalaska Lookout and its page gives Polk County (STATE/COUNTY TX/POLK). The FFLA list pairs the Polk Loc 1 record with it, since Loc 2 is in Trinity County; the NGS page gives no coordinates, so that pairing rests on name and county. The 1935 NGS page gives directions by dirt road from the Onalaska schoolhouse; those are 1935 directions and are not used for current access. The City of Onalaska history page returned HTTP 403 and was not used. The FFLA row for Loc 2 gives 'Pvt' where coordinates would be, and the page has no legend, so 'private' is not stated. No source found describes removal or the site today. Revised 2026-10-10: the story drops the unsupported 'private' label, says the Loc 1 match rests on name and county, and rewords the quoted phrases.
